svg.text: Picking a version moves every pane to it. The folder lists its entries
as they were then; a dot marks what that version changed. Nothing is
A row opens in the pane beside when there is one, so the list stays in
view. With a single pane it opens as a tab in the same one.
History and comments cover what's visible in any pane. It only says so
